title: polanisia hirta var. hanburyana
intro: Polanisia hirta var. hanburyana, commonly known as the Clammy Clover or Clammyweed, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cleomaceae. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and aiding in the treatment of various skin conditions due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polanisia hirta var. hanburyana include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant activity.
